rules.title: Loan existence and status validation
rules.statement: Raises LMS-001 if loan not found; raises LMS-021 if status is not ACTIVE.

rules.title: Quote date validation
rules.statement: Raises LMS-002 if p_quote_date is before v_loan.disb_date.

rules.title: Principal outstanding amount
rules.notes: Handles missing outstanding value via coalesce

rules.title: Interest rate selection
rules.statement: Uses v_loan.fixed_rate_pct when rate_type='FIXED'; otherwise uses latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before quote date plus spread_pct (coalesce to 0 if missing).
rules.notes: No declared precision on v_rate numeric

rules.title: Accrual day count and rounding
rules.statement: Computes days as greatest(quote_date - coalesce(last_run_date, disb_date), 0); adds to accrued_interest the value round(principal * rate/100 * days / (365 if day_count='ACT365' else 360), 2).
rules.notes: Single round to 2 decimals at end; day_count checked only for ACT365

rules.title: Penal interest passthrough
rules.statement: Sets o_penal directly to v_loan.accrued_penal with no further calculation.

rules.title: Outstanding fees passthrough
rules.statement: Sets o_fees directly to v_loan.fees_outstanding with no further calculation.

rules.title: Prepayment fee eligibility and calculation
rules.statement: Sets o_prepay_fee to 0; computes v_left as tenor_months minus full months since disb_date; if rate_type='FIXED' and prepay_fee_pct is not null and v_left > 3 then sets round(principal * prepay_fee_pct / 100, 2).
rules.notes: Rounding to 2 decimals; uses extract(year/month from age) for month count

rules.title: GST on fees and prepay fee
Total payoff amount
rules.statement: Sets o_total to greatest(principal + interest + penal + fees + prepay_fee + gst - advance_balance, 0).

rules.title: Quote validity period
rules.statement: Sets o_valid_until to p_quote_date + 2 (no calendar adjustment).

open_questions: Confirm that advance_balance is subtracted without coalesce and that negative result is forced to zero.
Confirm that no holiday or calendar adjustment is applied to the +2 day validity or to day counts.
Confirm that GST rate remains hard-coded at 18% and applies only to prepay_fee + fees.
